Split Wedge vs. Flexible Split-Wedge

The split wedge and flexible split-wedge designs address the same problem from a different angle — the flexible split-wedge achieves zero leakage at 6 bar air with lower required torque than a solid wedge, trading a more complex internal geometry for a real, quantified torque reduction.
